focus-modal-moves-outside-switch.one: Focus is not confined within a modal when using a switch control, so people who use a switch control to navigate content will be able to navigate outside of the modal, which may cause them to become disoriented. This occurs on the following page(s):
focus-modal-moves-outside-switch.multiple: Focus is not confined within multiple modals when using a switch control, so people who use a switch control to navigate content will be able to navigate outside of the modal, which may cause them to become disoriented. This occurs on the following page(s):
focus-modal-moves-outside-switch.short: Switch control focus is not maintained in modal

focus-modal-none.one: Keyboard focus is not moved to a modal when the modal opens, so people who use the keyboard to navigate content (including screen reader users) may not be able to use the modal, and in some cases may not know it is present on the page. This occurs on the following page(s):
focus-modal-none.multiple: For multiple modals, keyboard focus is not moved to the modal when the modal opens, so people who use the keyboard to navigate content (including screen reader users) may not be able to use each modal, and in some cases may not know it is present on the page. This occurs on the following page(s):
focus-modal-none.short: Keyboard focus is not placed on opened modal

focus-modal-not-returned.one: When a modal closes, keyboard focus is not returned to the control that opened the modal or to another logical location, so people who use the keyboard to navigate content (including screen reader users) may become disoriented on the page. This occurs on the following page(s):
focus-modal-not-returned.multiple: When a modal closes, keyboard focus is not returned to the control that opened the modal or to another logical location, so people who use the keyboard to navigate content (including screen reader users) may become disoriented on the page. This occurs on the following page(s):
focus-modal-not-returned.short: Modal is closed, focus is not returned to trigger

focus-not-moved.one: Keyboard focus does not follow the visual focus order, or it does not move to the intended target, so people who use the keyboard to navigate content (including screen reader users) may become disoriented on the page. This occurs on the following page(s):
focus-not-moved.multiple: Keyboard focus does not follow the visual focus order, or it does not move to the intended target, so people who use the keyboard to navigate content (including screen reader users) may become disoriented on the page. This occurs on the following page(s):
focus-not-moved.short: Keyboard focus does not move to intended target

focus-on-hidden-item.one: Keyboard focus or touch screen swiping goes to an element that is hidden or empty, so people who use the keyboard to navigate content (including screen reader users) may become disoriented or confused. This occurs on the following page(s):
focus-on-hidden-item.multiple: Keyboard focus or touch screen swiping goes to multiple elements that are hidden or empty, so people who use the keyboard to navigate content (including screen reader users) may become disoriented or confused. This occurs on the following page(s):
focus-on-hidden-item.short: Hidden or empty element receives focus

focus-on-hidden-item-switch.one: Switch control focus or touch screen swiping goes to an element that is hidden or empty, so people who use a switch control to navigate content may become disoriented or confused. This occurs on the following page(s):
focus-on-hidden-item-switch.multiple: Switch control or touch screen swiping goes to multiple elements that are hidden or empty, so people who use a switch control to navigate content may become disoriented or confused. This occurs on the following page(s):
focus-on-hidden-item-switch.short: Hidden or empty element receives switch control focus

tab-order-bad-index.one: The focus order is not logical and presents content in an order that misrepresents its meaning or operability, so people who use a keyboard, switch control, or other assistive technology to navigate content may become disoriented or confused. This occurs on the following page(s):
tab-order-bad-index.multiple: The focus order is not logical and presents content in an order that misrepresents its meaning or operability, so people who use a keyboard, switch control, or other assistive technology to navigate content may become disoriented or confused. This occurs on the following page(s):
tab-order-bad-index.short: Use of positive tabindex value is not logical

tab-order-illogical.one: The focus order is not logical and presents content in an order that misrepresents its meaning or operability, so people who use a keyboard, switch control, or other assistive technology to navigate content may become disoriented or confused. This occurs on the following page(s):
tab-order-illogical.multiple: The focus order is not logical and presents content in an order that misrepresents its meaning or operability, so people who use a keyboard, switch control, or other assistive technology to navigate content may become disoriented or confused. This occurs on the following page(s):
tab-order-illogical.short: Keyboard focus order is not logical

alt-text-image-map-nonunique.one: An area within an image map that acts as a link does not have a unique text alternative, so people who are blind and/or use a screen reader will not know where the link leads. This occurs on the following page(s):
alt-text-image-map-nonunique.multiple: Multiple areas within an image map that act as links do not have a unique text alternative, so people who are blind and/or use a screen reader will not know where these links lead. This occurs on the following page(s):
alt-text-image-map-nonunique.short: Non-unique text alternative for image map areas

link-purpose-unclear.one: The purpose of the link is not made clear by its text or the context provided by the content that immediately surrounds it, so people who are blind and/or use a screen reader will not know where the link goes. This occurs on the following page(s):
link-purpose-unclear.multiple: The purpose of multiple links is not made clear by each link's text or the context provided by the content that immediately surrounds it, so people who are blind and/or use a screen reader will not know where each link goes. This occurs on the following page(s):
link-purpose-unclear.short: Purpose of link is not clear in context

link-purpose-unclear-multiple.one: Multiple links have identical link text but different destinations, and the context provided by the content that immediately surrounds each link does not provide any clarification, so people who are blind and/or use a screen reader will not know or may be confused about where each link goes. This occurs on the following page(s):
link-purpose-unclear-multiple.multiple: Multiple links have identical link text but different destinations, and the context provided by the content that immediately surrounds each link does not provide any clarification, so people who are blind and/or use a screen reader will not know or may be confused about where each link goes. This occurs on the following page(s):
link-purpose-unclear-multiple.short: Multiple links have the same programmatic link text but different destinations

structure-finding-pages-difficult.one: Fewer than two ways to find other pages on the website are provided, so some people with disabilities may not be able to locate content on the site.
structure-finding-pages-difficult.multiple: Fewer than two ways to find other pages on the website are provided, so some people with disabilities may not be able to locate content on the site.
structure-finding-pages-difficult.short: Fewer than two ways provided to find other pages

heading-not-descriptive.one: A heading does not describe the content that follows it accurately, so people who are blind and/or use a screen reader and people with cognitive disabilities may be misled about the organization and structure of the page. This occurs on the following page(s):
heading-not-descriptive.multiple: Multiple headings do not describe the content that follows them accurately, so people who are blind and/or use a screen reader and people with cognitive disabilities may be misled about the organization and structure of the page. This occurs on the following page(s):

buttons-confusing.one: Multiple buttons have identical programmatic labels but different functionality, and there is no programmatic context, so people who are blind and/or use a screen reader will not know or may be confused or misled about what each button does. This occurs on the following page(s):
buttons-confusing.multiple: Multiple buttons have identical programmatic labels but different functionality, and there is no programmatic context, so people who are blind and/or use a screen reader will not know or may be confused or misled about what each button does. This occurs on the following page(s):
buttons-confusing.short: Controls have same name but different actions

label-not-descriptive.one: A label for a control or form input field does not convey the purpose of the control or input, so users may not understand what the control does or what data to enter, especially people with cognitive or learning disabilities and people who are blind and/or use a screen reader. This occurs on the following page(s):
label-not-descriptive.multiple: Multiple labels for controls or form input fields do not convey the purpose of the control or input, so users may not understand what the control does or what data to enter, especially people with cognitive or learning disabilities and people who are blind and/or use a screen reader. This occurs on the following page(s):
label-not-descriptive.short: Label does not convey purpose of control

label-programmatic-not-descriptive.one: A programmatic label for a control or form input field does not convey the purpose of the control or input, so people who are blind and/or use a screen reader may not understand what the control does or what data to enter. This occurs on the following page(s):
label-programmatic-not-descriptive.multiple: Multiple programmatic labels for controls or form input fields do not convey the purpose of the control or input, so people who are blind and/or use a screen reader may not understand what a control does or what data to enter. This occurs on the following page(s):
label-programmatic-not-descriptive.short: Programmatic label does not convey purpose of control

label-visible-not-descriptive.one: A visible label for a control or form input field does not convey the purpose of the control or input, so people who have cognitive or learning disabilities may not understand what the control does or what data to enter. This occurs on the following page(s):
label-visible-not-descriptive.multiple: Visible labels for multiple controls or form input fields do not convey the purpose of the control or input, so people who have cognitive or learning disabilities may not understand what a control does or what data to enter. This occurs on the following page(s):
label-visible-not-descriptive.short: Visible label does not convey purpose of control

title-iframe-duplicate.one: An iframe's title is not unique - another iframe on the same page has the same title, so people who are blind and/or use a screen reader will not be able to distinguish between the 2 iframes without entering and exploring them. This occurs on the following page(s):
title-iframe-duplicate.multiple: Multiple iframe titles are not unique - another iframe on the same page has the same title, so people who are blind and/or use a screen reader will not be able to distinguish between the iframes without entering and exploring them. This occurs on the following page(s):

title-iframe-not-meaningful.one: An iframe's title is not descriptive or meaningful, so people who are blind and/or use a screen reader will not know the purpose of the iframe without entering and exploring it. This occurs on the following page(s):
title-iframe-not-meaningful.multiple: Multiple iframe titles are not descriptive or meaningful, so people who are blind and/or use a screen reader will not know the purpose of the iframes without entering and exploring them. This occurs on the following page(s):
title-iframe-not-meaningful.short: title for iframe is not meaningful

focus-indicator-missing.one: An interactive element (such as a link, button, or form input) does not have a visual focus indicator, so sighted people who use a keyboard to navigate content will not know when that element is receiving focus. This occurs on the following page(s):
focus-indicator-missing.multiple: Multiple interactive elements (such as links, buttons, or form inputs) do not have a visual focus indicator, so sighted people who use a keyboard to navigate content will not know when those elements are receiving focus. This occurs on the following page(s):

focus-not-clearly-visible.one: The visual focus indicator for an interactive element (such as a link, button, or form input) is not visible, so sighted people who use a keyboard to navigate content will not know when that element is receiving focus. This occurs on the following page(s):
focus-not-clearly-visible.multiple: The visual focus indicator for multiple interactive elements (such as links, buttons, or form inputs) is not visible, so sighted people who use a keyboard to navigate content will not know when those elements are receiving focus. This occurs on the following page(s):

link-purpose-unclear-alone.one: The purpose of the link is not clear from its visible text, and there is no mechanism available to change or augment the link text to clarify its purpose, so people with cognitive or reading disabilities will not know or may be confused or misled about what the link does. This occurs on the following page(s):
link-purpose-unclear-alone.multiple: The purposes of multiple links are not clear from their visible text, and there is no mechanism available to change or augment the link text to clarify their purposes, so people with cognitive or reading disabilities will not know or may be confused or misled about what those links do. This occurs on the following page(s):
link-purpose-unclear-alone.short: Purpose of link is not clear from link text alone

touch-path-based-gesture-required.one: Functionality (excluding operating system, user agents [like a browser], or assistive technology functions) relies on path-based gestures that require the user to move the finger or pointer in a specific path or sequence, so people with motor disabilities or limited dexterity and people who use certain assistive technology to interact with the page will not be able to operate this functionality. This occurs on the following page(s):
touch-path-based-gesture-required.multiple: Functionality (excluding operating system, user agents [like a browser], or assistive technology functions) relies on path-based gestures that require the user to move the finger or pointer in a specific path or sequence, so people with motor disabilities or limited dexterity and people who use certain assistive technology to interact with the page will not be able to operate this functionality. This occurs on the following page(s):

touch-single-point-action-not-avail.one: Functionality (excluding operating system, user agents [like a browser], or assistive technology functions) relies on multipoint gestures that require more than one finger touching the screen at the same time (such as 2-finger pinch zoom), so people with motor disabilities or limited dexterity and people who use certain assistive technology to interact with the page that has a single pointer will not be able to operate this functionality. This occurs on the following page(s):
touch-single-point-action-not-avail.multiple: Functionality (excluding operating system, user agents [like a browser], or assistive technology functions) relies on multipoint gestures that require more than one finger touching the screen at the same time (such as 2-finger pinch zoom), so people with motor disabilities or limited dexterity and people who use certain assistive technology to interact with the page that has a single pointer will not be able to operate this functionality. This occurs on the following page(s):

touch-down-event.one: An irreversible action occurs on the down event of a control, so people with motor disabilities (such as tremors) may trigger unwanted actions. This occurs on the following page(s):
touch-down-event.multiple: An irreversible action occurs on the down event of multiple controls, so people with motor disabilities (such as tremors) may trigger unwanted actions. This occurs on the following page(s):
touch-down-event.short: Irreversible action occurs on down event

speech-accessible-name-interspersed.one: The accessible name of an interactive element (such as a link, button, or form input) includes the visible label but has other words interspersed, so people who use speech input to navigate and operate content will not be able to access the element. This occurs on the following page(s):
speech-accessible-name-interspersed.multiple: The accessible name of multiple interactive elements (such as links, buttons, or form inputs) includes the visible label but has other words interspersed, so people who use speech input to navigate and operate content will not be able to access those elements. This occurs on the following page(s):

speech-accessible-name-mismatch.one: The accessible name of an interactive element (such as a link, button, or form input) does not contain the visible label, so people who use speech input to navigate and operate content will not be able to access the element. This occurs on the following page(s):
speech-accessible-name-mismatch.multiple: The accessible name of multiple interactive elements (such as links, buttons, or form inputs) does not contain the visible label, so people who use speech input to navigate and operate content will not be able to access those elements. This occurs on the following page(s):
speech-accessible-name-mismatch.short: Accessible name does not contain visible label

speech-accessible-name-missing.one: An interactive element (such as a link, button, or form input) does not have an accessible name because its visible label is not programmatically associated with the element, so people who use speech input to navigate and operate content will not be able to access the element. This occurs on the following page(s):
speech-accessible-name-missing.multiple: Multiple interactive elements (such as links, buttons, or form inputs) do not have an accessible name because their visible labels are not programmatically associated with the elements, so people who use speech input to navigate and operate content will not be able to access those elements. This occurs on the following page(s):

speech-accessible-name-order.one: The accessible name of an interactive element (such as a link, button, or form input) contains its visible label, but the words are in a different order, so the accessible name does not contain the visible label, and people who use speech input to navigate and operate content will not be able to access the element. This occurs on the following page(s):
speech-accessible-name-order.multiple: The accessible name of multiple interactive elements (such as links, buttons, or form inputs) contains their visible labels, but the words are in a different order, so the accessible names do not contain the visible labels, and people who use speech input to navigate and operate content will not be able to access these elements. This occurs on the following page(s):
speech-accessible-name-order.short: Accessible name not same order as visible label

motion-actuation-cannot-disable.one: Motion actuation cannot be disabled, meaning persons with motor difficulties may not be able to use the function or accidentally trigger it on the following page(s):
motion-actuation-cannot-disable.multiple: Motion actuation cannot be disabled, meaning persons with motor difficulties may not be able to use the function or accidentally trigger it on the following page(s):

motion-actuation-disrupts-system.one: Motion actuation (such as changing the device orientation, moving the device in a particular way, or gesturing near the device) disrupts or disables system level features, so people with motor disabilities (such as tremors or spasticity) may unintentionally trigger some functionality. This occurs on the following page(s):
motion-actuation-disrupts-system.multiple: Motion actuation (such as changing the device orientation, moving the device in a particular way, or gesturing near the device) disrupts or disables system level features, so people with motor disabilities (such as tremors or spasticity) may unintentionally trigger some functionality. This occurs on the following page(s):
motion-actuation-disrupts-system.short: Motion actuation disrupts or disables system features

motion-actuation-required.one: Motion actuation (such as changing the device orientation, moving the device in a particular way, or gesturing near the device) is required to activate a function, so people with motor disabilities (such as tremors or spasticity) may not be able to use the function or they may accidentally trigger the function. This occurs on the following page(s):
motion-actuation-required.multiple: Motion actuation (such as changing the device orientation, moving the device in a particular way, or gesturing near the device) is required to activate a function, so people with motor disabilities (such as tremors or spasticity) may not be able to use the function or they may accidentally trigger the function. This occurs on the following page(s):

touch-size-small.one: The hit area of an interactive element (such as a link, button, or form input) does not meet the minimum size - 44 pixels wide x 44 pixels height - so people with motor disabilities (such as tremors or spasticity) may not be able to activate the element. This occurs on the following page(s):
touch-size-small.multiple: The hit areas of multiple interactive elements (such as links, buttons, or form inputs) do not meet the minimum size - 44 pixels wide x 44 pixels height - so people with motor disabilities (such as tremors or spasticity) may not be able to activate those elements. This occurs on the following page(s):

content-restricts-input-mechanisms.one: Certain input methods for interactive elements (such as using a mouse on a touch screen device) are not allowed, so people with disabilities that do not permitted to use the allowed methods may not be able to activate those elements. This occurs on the following page(s):
content-restricts-input-mechanisms.multiple: Certain input methods for interactive elements (such as using a mouse on a touch screen device) are not allowed, so people with disabilities that do not permitted to use the allowed methods may not be able to activate those elements. This occurs on the following page(s):

dragging-no-alternative.one: Some functionality relies on a dragging movement with no single-pointer, single-touch alternative, making it difficult or impossible for persons with motor difficulties and users of assistive technology to perform the gesture on the following page(s):
dragging-no-alternative.multiple: Some functionality relies on a dragging movement with no single-pointer, single-touch alternative, making it difficult or impossible for persons with motor difficulties and users of assistive technology to perform the gesture on the following page(s):
dragging-no-alternative.short: Functionality requires a dragging movement with no alternative

target-size-small.one: A target's hit area does not meet a minimum 24x24 pixel size or spacing. making it difficult for users with hand tremors and those who have difficulty with fine motor movement to activate them accurately. This occurs on the following page(s):
target-size-small.multiple: Multiple target hit areas do not meet a minimum 24x24 pixel size or spacing. making it difficult for users with hand tremors and those who have difficulty with fine motor movement to activate them accurately. This occurs on the following page(s):
target-size-small.short: Target does not meet minimum size or spacing

lang-invalid.one: The page does not have a valid language assigned, so screen readers may mispronounce content. This occurs on the following page(s):
lang-invalid.multiple: Multiple pages do not have a valid language assigned, so screen readers may mispronounce content. This occurs on the following page(s):
lang-invalid.short: Value of the lang attribute is not valid

lang-not-accurate.one: The language programmatically assigned to a page is incorrect, so screen readers may mispronounce content. This occurs on the following page(s):
lang-not-accurate.multiple: The language programmatically assigned to multiple pages is incorrect, so screen readers may mispronounce content. This occurs on the following page(s):
lang-not-accurate.short: Lang attribute for page is not primary page language

lang-not-defined.one: No language is programmatically assigned to a page, so screen readers may mispronounce content. This occurs on the following page(s):
lang-not-defined.multiple: No language is programmatically assigned to multiple pages, so screen readers may mispronounce content. This occurs on the following page(s):
lang-not-defined.short: Primary language of the page is not defined

lang-change-not-marked.one: A portion of content on a page that is in a different language from the rest of the content on the page is not programmatically assigned the language for that portion of content, so screen readers may mispronounce that part of the content. This occurs on the following page(s):
lang-change-not-marked.multiple: Portions of content on multiple pages that are in a different language from the rest of the content on the page are not programmatically assigned the language for the portion of content, so screen readers may mispronounce those parts of the content. This occurs on the following page(s):
lang-change-not-marked.short: Change in language is not marked

lang-change-not-valid.one: A portion of content on a page that is in a different language from the rest of the content on the page does not have a valid language programmatically for that portion, so screen readers may mispronounce that part of the content. This occurs on the following page(s):
lang-change-not-valid.multiple: Portions of content on multiple pages that are in a different language from the rest of the content on the page do not have a valid language programmatically for each portion, so screen readers may mispronounce those parts of the content. This occurs on the following page(s):
lang-change-not-valid.short: The change in language for a portion of content is not correct

focus-moves-on-load.one: When a page loads, another window opens unexpectedly and focus moves to the new window, so people who use a keyboard to navigate content (including screen reader users) may become confused or disoriented. This occurs on the following page(s):
focus-moves-on-load.multiple: When a page loads, another window opens unexpectedly and focus moves to the new window, so people who use a keyboard to navigate content (including screen reader users) may become confused or disoriented. This occurs on the following page(s):
focus-moves-on-load.short: New window opens on page load

focus-submits-form.one: When an element on the page receives focus, this causes a form to be submitted without the user activating a control, so people who use the keyboard or other assistive technologies (such as a switch control) to navigate content may not be able to complete that form or control when the form is submitted. This occurs on the following pages:
focus-submits-form.multiple: When an element on the page receives focus, this causes a form to be submitted without the user activating a control, so people who use the keyboard or other assistive technologies (such as a switch control) to navigate content may not be able to complete that form or control when the form is submitted. This occurs on the following pages:
focus-submits-form.short: Form is automatically submitted when component receives focus

focus-visual-affects-keyboard.one: When an element receives keyboard focus, focus is automatically removed or redirected, so people who use a keyboard to navigate content (including screen reader users) may become confused or disoriented. This occurs on the following page(s):
focus-visual-affects-keyboard.multiple: When multiple elements receive keyboard focus, focus is automatically removed or redirected, so people who use a keyboard to navigate content (including screen reader users) may become confused or disoriented. This occurs on the following page(s):
focus-visual-affects-keyboard.short: Keyboard focus is unexpectedly removed or redirected

focus-visual-affects-screen-reader.one: When an element receives screen reader focus, focus is automatically removed or redirected, so people who use a screen reader may become confused or disoriented. This occurs on the following page(s):
focus-visual-affects-screen-reader.multiple: When multiple elements receive screen reader focus, focus is automatically removed or redirected, so people who use a screen reader may become confused or disoriented. This occurs on the following page(s):
focus-visual-affects-screen-reader.short: Screen reader focus is unexpectedly removed or redirected

focus-visual-affects-switch.one: When an element receives switch control focus, focus is automatically removed or redirected, so people who use a switch control to navigate content may become confused or disoriented. This occurs on the following page(s):
focus-visual-affects-switch.multiple: When multiple elements receive switch control focus, focus is automatically removed or redirected, so people who use a switch control to navigate content may become confused or disoriented. This occurs on the following page(s):
focus-visual-affects-switch.short: Switch control focus is unexpectedly removed or redirected

focus-window-launches.one: When an element receives focus, a new window launches unexpectedly, so people who use a keyboard to navigate content (including screen reader users) may become confused or disoriented. This occurs on the following page(s):
focus-window-launches.multiple: When multiple elements receive focus, a new window launches unexpectedly, so people who use a keyboard to navigate content (including screen reader users) may become confused or disoriented. This occurs on the following page(s):
focus-window-launches.short: New window launched when component receives focus

unexpected-change-on-focus.one: When an element receives keyboard focus, it results in a substantial, unanticipated context change (such as a change in the page content that changes the meaning of the page), so people who use a keyboard to navigate content (including screen reader users) may become confused or disoriented. This occurs on the following page(s):
unexpected-change-on-focus.multiple: When multiple elements receive keyboard focus, it results in a substantial, unanticipated context change (such as a change in the page content that changes the meaning of the page), so people who use a keyboard to navigate content (including screen reader users) may become confused or disoriented. This occurs on the following page(s):
unexpected-change-on-focus.short: There is a substantial, unannounced context change on focus

unexpected-change-on-focus-screen-reader.one: When a component receives screen reader focus, it results in a substantial, unanticipated context change (such as a change in the page content that changes the meaning of the page), so people who use a screen reader may become confused or disoriented. This occurs on the following page(s):
unexpected-change-on-focus-screen-reader.multiple: When multiple components receive screen reader focus, it results in a substantial, unanticipated context change (such as a change in the page content that changes the meaning of the page), so people who use a screen reader may become confused or disoriented. This occurs on the following page(s):
unexpected-change-on-focus-screen-reader.short: There is a substantial, unannounced context change on screen reader focus

unexpected-change-on-focus-switch.one: When a component receives switch control focus, it results in a substantial, unanticipated context change (such as a change in the page content that changes the meaning of the page), so people who use a switch control to navigate content may become confused or disoriented. This occurs on the following page(s):
unexpected-change-on-focus-switch.multiple: When multiple components receive switch control focus, it results in a substantial, unanticipated context change (such as a change in the page content that changes the meaning of the page), so people who use a switch control to navigate content may become confused or disoriented. This occurs on the following page(s):
unexpected-change-on-focus-switch.short: There is a substantial, unannounced context change on switch control focus

unexpected-change-on-interaction.one: When a user changes the setting of a user interface control (such as entering text in an input field or selecting a checkbox or radio button), it results in an unanticipated context change (such as opening a new window, moving focus to another element, or submitting a form), so people who have cognitive disabilities and others may be confused or disoriented. This occurs on the following page(s):
unexpected-change-on-interaction.multiple: When a user changes the setting of some user interface controls (such as entering text in an input field or selecting a checkbox or radio button), it results in an unanticipated context change (such as opening a new window, moving focus to another element, or submitting a form), so people who have cognitive disabilities and others may be confused or disoriented. This occurs on the following page(s):

unexpected-change-select.one: When navigating a dropdown with the arrow keys, moving to an option but not selecting it, results in an unexpected change of context (such as moving focus to another element or changing the content of the page), so people who use a keyboard to navigate content (including screen reader users) may become confused or disoriented. This occurs on the following page(s):
unexpected-change-select.multiple: When navigating some dropdowns with the arrow keys, moving to an option but not selecting it, results in an unexpected change of context (such as moving focus to another element or changing the content of the page), so people who use a keyboard to navigate content (including screen reader users) may become confused or disoriented. This occurs on the following page(s):
unexpected-change-select.short: Arrow keys activate dropdown menu options

unexpected-window-launch.one: When a user enters text in an input field or selects a checkbox or radio button, a new window unexpectedly opens, so people who have cognitive disabilities and others may be confused or disoriented. This occurs on the following page(s):
